brief.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: one finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, landscape PNG 1536 x 864 (16:9), high resolution.
Create a brand new image for the basketball fan publication バスケまとめ. Use the already viewed black/lime approved Culver thumbnail only as a style reference: deep near-black #151A18, acid lime #CCF43B, warm off-white, expressive hand-painted ink and dry-brush strokes, bold Japanese typography, strong spacious hierarchy. Do NOT reuse that reference's player, pose, text, scores, date, or layout.
Subject identity reference: the last viewed official profile portrait is the real player Ryuya Kaneda / 金田龍弥 of Kobe Storks. Draw ONLY this one real person, in a new playing pose. Preserve his recognizable face: clean-shaven elongated oval face and tapered rounded chin, dark almond-shaped eyes, straight dark eyebrows, straight medium-width nose with rounded tip, medium lips, long neck, lean tall athletic build, dark medium-length curtain hair with a near-center part exposing the forehead, swept gently outward around ears. Include the small cheek mole subtly. Do not use a generic invented athlete, do not substitute the face from the style reference.
Composition: dynamic illustrated Kaneda on the LEFT 40 percent, driving forward diagonally with torso leaning, knees flexed, orange basketball controlled at the near-side waist by one anatomically correct hand, other arm naturally bent for balance. Three-quarter face clearly visible and sufficiently large to recognize. Head, ball and both hands wholly inside the canvas with breathing room. Crop naturally at mid-thigh near the lower edge. Plain dark-green/black basketball kit, clean unmarked fabric with subtle ivory/lime edges, no jersey lettering or numbers at all. No tattoos invented. Entire subject must be visibly hand-drawn with expressive black ink contours and textured ivory shadows, not a photograph, not photorealistic, not a photo collage.
Background: sparse near-black field with one diagonal lime dry-brush sweep behind the player for motion. Keep the RIGHT 55 percent quiet for headline copy. No additional humans, crowd, arena logos or scoreboard. Ball is a prop held by the person.
Editorial meaning: the article is a TEAM ANALYSIS of Kobe Storks' most recent FIVE games, November 7–18, 2026, with 1 win and 4 losses and paint scoring central to points conceded. Player was RANDOMLY selected among names in the article solely as a visual subject. It is an imagined basketball pose, never a recreation of an actual game or scoring event. Do not mention his name, personal statistics, participation, success or failure anywhere in the image. No league rankings or new facts.
Text (verbatim, Japanese, absolutely correct and clearly readable):
top small publication line: "バスケまとめ"
right top team header, bold off-white: "神戸ストークス"
right upper small line: "直近5試合｜11/7〜11/18"
right upper-middle medium bold: "1勝4敗"
right main headline in two large lines: "失点の中心は" and "ペイント内"
bottom safe-area label: "イラスト（AI生成）" and "イメージ"
All text is horizontal. Make ペイント内 the dominant lime headline; 失点の中心は off-white, substantially large. Team header establishes all numbers and claims as team-level. The record is a supporting fact, not bigger than the main headline. Typography should be heavy, readable Japanese sans-serif with restrained rough ink edge treatment. Bottom labels must be readable, not tiny. Keep all text within generous 50px safe margins, clear of the person and brush edges.
Constraints: Exactly one thumbnail; no borders, no multi-panel grids, no extra words, no English text other than AI within the required label, no athlete name, no date other than stated date range, no watermarks, no team/league/sponsor logos, no pasted official photos. Photographs only inform likeness. Do not include 38 points, Culver, Sendai, or any text from the style reference. Anatomically plausible hands and body. Opaque background.

generator.inspection_method: 内蔵生成ツールの画像表示および保存元PNGのview_imageを実見。sipsで画像寸法とPNG形式を確認。

inspection_notes.text_and_numbers: チーム名、直近5試合、11/7〜11/18、1勝4敗、見出しが固定原稿と一致することを画像で確認。
inspection_notes.source_qualifiers: 対象期間が表示され、特定試合の再現やランダム選手の成績・出場・活躍を示す文字がなく、イメージ表記があることを画像で確認。
inspection_notes.likeness_or_no_named_person: 金田龍弥の公式写真で見た髪型・輪郭・眉・目鼻・ひげのない顔・頬のほくろをイラストと比較。人物は1人で、個人名の表示なし。
inspection_notes.layout: 顔、ボール、両手、見出し、注記が画面内に収まり、文字と顔の重なりなし。両手の指と関節に目立つ破綻なし。太ももでの意図した人物トリミング。
inspection_notes.ai_label: 『イラスト（AI生成）』『イメージ』が画面右下に読める大きさで存在。
